import sys


def main():
    jobs = []
    for line in sys.stdin:
        parts = line.strip().split()
        if parts:
            name, arrival, duration, priority = parts
            jobs.append((name, int(arrival), int(duration), int(priority)))

    # Sort jobs by priority descending, then arrival time ascending, then name ascending
    jobs.sort(key=lambda j: (-j[3], j[1], j[0]))

    current_time = 0
    idle_time = 0
    for name, arrival, duration, priority in jobs:
        if arrival > current_time:
            idle_time += arrival - current_time
            current_time = arrival
        print(f"{name} {current_time} {current_time + duration}")
        current_time += duration
    print(f"idle {idle_time}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
